# Why Veles is spelled that way — and what it costs to get it right

There is a version of this name the early internet had to settle for: *veles*. This is the file on how **Veles** replaced it.

The stories of Veles place cattle, commerce, underworld at the center of a living mythological world.

## At a Glance

- **Restored name:** Veles
- **ASCII form:** veles
- **Meaning:** "Cattle god, possibly wool"
- **Domain of influence:** Cattle, Commerce, Underworld
- **Pantheon:** Slavic
- **Classification:** Tier 2
- **Original script:** —
- **Series:** The Restoration Files, No. 512 of 542

## The Name Before the Marks


Spoken, the name runs `/veles/` — say "veles" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Veles".

## The Temple That Stands Now

The restored name is not a plaque; it is an address. The temple of **Veles** lives at [/veles/](/veles/), with its mythology in the [lore halls](/veles/lore/), its peer-reviewed record in the [Scholarly Edition](/veles/scholars/), and its place in the pattern atlas on the [patterns floor](/veles/patterns/).

Tier-2 here means one preserved truth — not less important, just singular. The temple shows it and names it.

## The Archetype at Work

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) seats this temple in **4 industries**, each match argued and weighted: **Funerary & Memorial Services** (primary seat: Veles embodies cattle, commerce, underworld — the core of funerary memorial.); **Finance, Wealth & Commerce** (resonant seat: Veles shares symbolic territory with finance commerce.); **Gaming, Fantasy & Entertainment IP** (resonant seat: Veles shares symbolic territory with gaming entertainment.). The [Resonance File](/veles/blog/resonance/) reads those seats through the myths themselves.

## The Emblems

The name does not travel alone. **Name** — The restored form Veles, carrying scholarly and cultural weight.; **Domain** — Cattle, Commerce, Underworld. Each emblem is filed in the temple's record with its own provenance, the same discipline the spelling gets.

## For the Voice

Say "veles" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Veles". The reconstructed line runs `/veles/` — the temple's pronunciation atlas carries the phonemes one by one.

## The Discipline It Answers To

This restoration belongs to Slavic, a tradition with its own exact discipline. The rules that govern it are not house style; they are the tradition's own scholarship, applied with the same care here as in any edition — and published, with the sources, so the file can be checked the way an edition can be checked. Tier-2 here means one preserved truth — not less important, just singular. The temple shows it and names it.
